prompt:
Please write a Python MCP server named "example_mcp" that implements one tool named "example_search_users" which allows searching for users by a query string matching their names or emails. The tool should accept parameters: query (string, min length 2, max 200), limit (int, 1-100, default 20), offset (int, 0 or more, default 0), and response_format (enum "markdown" or "json", default markdown).

The tool must make an async API GET request to the endpoint https://api.example.com/v1/users/search with query parameters q, limit, offset.

The tool must return results either as human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON according to the response_format.

Markdown format should include a header with the query, a count of total users found, and list each user with their name and id as a heading and email and team as bullet points.

JSON format must return an object with total, count, offset, and users array with keys id, name, email, and optional team.

Use an async HTTP client and proper exception handling to provide clear error strings for HTTP errors (404, 403, 429) and timeouts.

Implement input validation with Pydantic BaseModel and use Pydantic v2 features (model_config, field_validator).

Set a CHARACTER_LIMIT constant to 25000 characters and truncate the response if it exceeds this limit, appending a truncation notice.

Provide complete docstrings on the tool describing inputs, outputs, errors, and usage examples.

The server must run on Python 3.11.

Your final output must be a runnable Python script suitable for FastMCP. Do NOT include any other files.

Output the full Python MCP server source as a single file named example_mcp.py with all dependencies and imports handled.
